questions.question: The recorder is registered on PreToolUse and PostToolUse only. If someone later registers it on another event (e.g. PostToolUseFailure), what should it do with that payload?

options.label: Keep under raw name (Recommended)
options.description: Append a line with event=<hook_event_name> and the whole payload. Nothing is lost; readers skip unknown kinds, as the amended RFC requires. Current implementation.

options.label: Drop it
options.description: Write nothing for unregistered events. The log only ever holds asked/answered; a future registration silently records nothing until the recorder is extended.
